overrideReason: Codex hit a multi-day usage block partway through this story (all 3 attempts under the retired US-1007 id produced 0 tokens; confirmed via direct probe: 'try again at Oct 4th, 2026 2:11 PM'). The owner explicitly chose (via AskUserQuestion) to have this final PRD-010 story implemented directly rather than wait five days. tests/test_integrity_adversarial.py was written by hand, exercising the REAL implementations from US-1002 (SQL frozen/freshness logic), US-1003 (frontend stale-self-check classifier), and US-1009 (coverage codegen gate) rather than any simplified re-derivation, per the story's own explicit instruction. Each of the 5 machine-checkable criteria was independently run and passed: C1 seeds a throwaway-schema Postgres database with real distinct-source_timestamp rows at exactly, one-under, and boundary-with-one-differing-value counts and asserts the real integrity_read RPC's frozen/frozen_state fields at each point. C2 seeds a real derives_from dependent (btc_rsi) with genuinely moving values while its real root (btc_daily_close) is frozen, and confirms the dependent still reports frozen - proving propagation, not independent detection. C3 seeds stablecoin_supply (a real freshness_unmeasurable entry) with both a brand-new and a 10-year-old row and confirms both report 'unmeasurable', never a numeric freshness state. C4 runs the real, unmodified classifyIntegritySelfCheck function from web/src/integrity.ts via a Node/vite-node subprocess against a real stale and a real current computed_at. C5 injects a genuine byte-for-byte copy-pasted placeholder golden into the real tests/goldens directory and runs the real, unmodified US-1009 coverage test (tests/test_registry_codegen.py::test_every_generated_key_has_a_real_golden_and_the_goldens_have_substance) as a subprocess, confirming it fails - then restores the original file and reconfirms the gate is green again. Full suite re-run after all of this: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration" (509 passed, up from 504 with these 5 new tests), npm --prefix web test (83/83), npm --prefix web run typecheck (clean). C6 and C7 (the [cmd:] gates) are these same commands. C8 is the story's own [human] criterion and is deliberately left unjudged here for the owner's separate G6_HUMAN gate, per this project's established rule that no agent may satisfy a [human] criterion - passes is set to false until that gate closes.

results.note: Exactly frozen_after_observations (3, read from the real shipped registry) identical distinct-timestamp rows report frozen; one fewer reports not_frozen; the same count with one differing value reports not_frozen. All three cases run against the real integrity_read RPC on a throwaway-schema real Postgres database.

btc_rsi (a real derives_from=btc_daily_close entry from the shipped registry) is seeded with 5 genuinely different, moving RSI values while its root is frozen. The real RPC still reports the dependent frozen, proving propagation over the root's honesty rather than an independent identical-value check on the dependent's own moving values.
stablecoin_supply (a real freshness_unmeasurable entry) reports 'unmeasurable' for both a brand-new row and a row backdated 10 years, proven at both ends of the boundary against the real RPC.

Runs the real, unmodified classifyIntegritySelfCheck from web/src/integrity.ts via a Node subprocess. A computed_at just past INTEGRITY_SELF_CHECK_STALE_AFTER_MS classifies as stale-self-check; a current one classifies as current.

Injects a real byte-for-byte copy of btc_daily_close's golden onto eth_rsi's golden path, runs the real US-1009 coverage test as a subprocess, and confirms it fails (exit code != 0) rather than accepting the placeholder. The original file is restored and the gate is reconfirmed green afterward.
